ModMetaData.name: Matrilineal Gene
ModMetaData.author: William
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a specialized matrilineal reproduction gene to RimWorld Biotech.
Carriers of this gene (or partners of carriers) will only give birth to female offspring. Furthermore, daughters born from a matrilineal lineage directly inherit their mother's full genetic makeup, Xenotype definition, and custom xenotype identity, preserving pure matriarchal lineages across generations.
FEATURES: - All-Female Births: 100% guarantee of female children for natural births and Growth Vats. - Matrilineal Xenotype Inheritance: Daughters inherit their genetic mother's Xenotype and Endogenes instead of dissolving into random hybrids. - Biotech Integration: Fully extractable, combinable in Genepacks, and usable in custom Xenotypes. - Full Localization: English and Vietnamese translations included.
